description: This file defines the SugarChartFactory class, which is responsible for creating instances of chart engine objects based on configuration and parameters. It includes logic for selecting and requiring appropriate PHP files for different chart engines and modules.

classes.name: SugarChartFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating chart engine instances based on configuration and parameters.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a chart engine object instance based on the specified chart engine and module, loading the appropriate PHP file.
